basic_profile.bio: A 29-year-old Star Wars enthusiast from Manchester, UK, who recently discovered the world of online collecting communities. I spend my free time hunting for rare action figures and discussing the latest releases. Outside of this hobby, I work in an IT support role, which aligns well with my interest in technology. Not currently in a relationship, I often find myself browsing Reddit late into the night, especially on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge of action figures primarily comes from a lifelong passion for Star Wars and self-teaching through online forums and YouTube channels. I have a basic understanding of the market trends and rarity of figures, thanks to hours spent lurking on collector forums and watching unboxing videos.
